subject: Subprocessor geolocation, retention exhibit, and certification artifacts
messages:
From: Hector Morales <hector@corebank.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: CoreBank Legal <legal@corebank.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Subprocessor inventory + geo/retention confirmation for procurement

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. Procurement & our security team have a couple of follow-ups before we can proceed:

1) Full subprocessor inventory (CSV preferred) including country of processing, subprocessors used for telemetry/observability, cache & CDN, and any edge-side proxies.
2) Retention periods by data type (logs, telemetry, request metadata, customer blobs) and whether retention varies by region.
3) Any certified attestations (KMS/HSM usage, SOC2 snapshot, encryption-in-transit details) you can share as a short exhibit.
4) If any subprocessors process EU personal data, a map of transfers (dataflow diagram or short bullet list) and whether you rely on Standard Contractual Clauses or onshore fallback routes.

We'd like to have the artifacts by end of day Wednesday PDT to keep the bid timeline. If any of this requires a DPA addendum, flag that and we'll route internally.

Appreciate it — Hector
Hector Morales
Senior Vendor Risk Manager, CoreBank
hector@corebank.com

--
Note: Procurement will push for an explicit retention exhibit attached to the DPA.

- On EU transfers: we use SCCs for hosted accounts by default; for Dedicated/Private customers we offer onshore routing where requested — I'll include a short dataflow note.
- If CoreBank needs a DPA addendum for retention carveouts we can prepare one; please indicate whether you need a formal DocuSign route.

Deliverables attached in follow-up from Kimberly.

Best,

Hector — attaching the corrected artifacts per Priyom's note. Key callouts below.

Attachments: subprocessor_roster_v2.csv (CSV), retention_matrix_202606.pdf (PDF), kms_hsm_attestation_snapshot.txt (TXT)

Summary of changes and answers:
- Roster: added explicit processing country column for each subprocessor and a role column (e.g., CDN, telemetry, caching, KMS). The CSV includes a small column for whether the processor handles EU-data-by-default.
- Retention: retention_matrix_202606.pdf lists retention ranges and the justification for each class (operational logs 30-90 days, telemetry aggregates 13 months, request metadata 90 days default with per-account overrides). We've flagged fields where Dedicated customers can opt into onshore retention.
- KMS/HSM: kms_hsm_attestation_snapshot.txt is a short summary of our KMS rotation & HSM usage for private deployments; for hosted accounts we use managed KMS with customer key options on Dedicated/Private.
- Transfers & Controls: For hosted customers in the EU we rely on SCCs plus encryption-in-transit; we include an optional onshore fallback for Dedicated accounts. There's a one-page dataflow diagram linked here: https://redwood.app/drive/CoreBank/DPA-addendum-draft (see section 2.1).

Kimberly (privacy): If CoreBank requires a formal attestation or additional evidence (e.g., SOC2 dated copy), we can provide redacted artifact under NDA — let us know specifically which artifact and what redaction level is acceptable.

Internal note to Marissa: please ensure logs retention policy doc location is current in the console export before I send the final packet.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Privacy Compliance, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Subprocessor inventory + geo/retention confirmation for procurement

Kimberly — thanks for the fast turnaround and the attachments. A few quick follow-ups from vendor risk: 

- The roster looks good; can you add a column indicating whether each subprocessors' access is full (plaintext), tokenized, or no-access? That will help our risk scoring.
- Retention matrix: can you confirm whether any logs are stored outside customer region for longer than 72 hours? If so, please call those out; otherwise note 'no long-term cross-region log storage'.
- KMS/HSM: the snapshot is helpful — can you provide an attestation of HSM use for dedicated deployments (simple one-paragraph statement we can keep with the file)?
- We will need a DPA addendum for retention carveouts if Redwood enforces a shorter retention window than our default (CoreBank requires minimum 12 months for telemetry aggregates). Please propose language or confirm you will accept the carveout via addendum.

If you can send the small roster column + one-paragraph HSM attestation by EOD tomorrow we'll be able to move this to legal review. Also confirm whether Docusign for a DPA addendum is preferred or email-signed exhibits are acceptable.

Best,
Hector

Attachments: none
